title: webvise Is Now an OpenAI Select Partner
excerpt: webvise has been named an OpenAI Select Partner within the OpenAI Partner Network, and will continue working with OpenAI to help organizations build, deploy, and scale AI solutions responsibly and effectively.
metaDescription: webvise has been named an OpenAI Select Partner within the OpenAI Partner Network, working with OpenAI to help organizations build, deploy, and scale AI.

blocks.text: Potsdam, Germany, July 17, 2026. webvise, a design-first studio for custom software and AI automation, today announced that it has been named an **OpenAI Select Partner** within the OpenAI Partner Network.

The OpenAI Partner Network is a global program for partners to build, sell, and deliver AI solutions with OpenAI. It brings together partners with deep industry expertise, delivery capabilities, and customer relationships while equipping them with resources, enablement, and support to help enterprises adopt OpenAI frontier models and products and turn them into measurable impact.

As an OpenAI Select Partner, webvise will continue working with OpenAI to help organizations build, deploy, and scale AI solutions responsibly and effectively. This work helps organizations get more useful work from every token and stronger performance per dollar with GPT-5.6, while using ChatGPT Work to turn ambitious goals into finished work. webvise designs, builds, and automates the internal tools, portals, dashboards, and agentic workflows that small and mid-sized businesses run on.

"OpenAI models already run in production systems webvise ships, from tender processing to quantity takeoffs. The partnership formalizes that work and gives clients a direct channel into the platform their workflows depend on," said Sebastian Kehle, Founder, webvise.

webvise supports organizations across construction, media, finance, and professional services with [AI consulting](/services/ai-consulting), [AI automation](/services/ai-automation), and custom software development. Recent work includes an internal AI portal for a German construction company, where two agents convert tender PDFs into valid GAEB D83 files and produce quantity takeoffs from plan PDFs, with selectable frontier models and per-run cost tracking.

Looking ahead, webvise plans to complete OpenAI's PartnerU enablement tracks for building and deploying, expand its OpenAI-backed automation offerings, and scale customer deployments, helping clients translate AI ambition into business outcomes.
For inquiries about the partnership or a project, [get in touch](/#contact).
